label: Late-episode D1 after an a1 -> S2 rare transition
explanation: Fires only at D1 steps (never GO/D2) and only late in the episode (ep_trial >= ~80, mostly 90-99), when the value head is low. The strongest activations (top windows, near max) come at D1 right after the previous trial was a1 that rarely reached S2; this clause gets ~0.91 precision but only ~0.52 recall and ~0.75 of the activation mass on dev. Missed activations are weaker ones at other late-episode D1 steps (after common transitions, a2 choices, and either reward), so the feature is a broad weak late-episode D1 signal, and an a1->S2 rare previous trial strongly raises its magnitude. Uses only observed history (previous action and transition) plus the time in the episode. Phase/time alone (D1 & ep_trial >= 85) gets recall 0.92 but precision 0.17.
